BB child-thread dispatch, bounded cleanup and exact-artifact review
approval boundary for send, publish, spend, and external writes

lifecycle.setup: Install the complete root skill bundle, a plugin, or setup --target operator. Invoke the parent explicitly. For BB teams, run hosts/coding-agent/team.mjs with an existing project, environment and parent. Activation defaults to manual; no process starts on installation.
lifecycle.upgrade: Use the installer or host manager that owns the copy. Preserve the source, scope and host settings; hosts do not fetch during tasks.
lifecycle.remove: Disconnect host routing and stop any active teams before removing the unchanged owned folder. User artifacts, host settings and other activated copies remain host-owned.
